title: Card Grid MVP
description:
## <custom data-type="emoji" data-id="id-0">:person_with_crown:</custom> User Story

As a website visitor, I want to view content displayed in a responsive card grid so that I can quickly browse multiple options and easily access the information I'm interested in.

---

## <custom data-type="emoji" data-id="id-1">:gorilla:</custom> Goal

* Increase engagement rates by presenting information in easily digestible "bites"
* Support the visual hierarchy of the website and highlight important content
* Clearly display multiple content options so users can quickly compare and select
* Improve the user experience through consistent design and intuitive navigation

---

## <custom data-type="emoji" data-id="id-2">:clipboard:</custom> Requirements

* The card grid should display 1-4 cards per row depending on screen size
* On desktop, the grid should display 4 columns maximum
* On tablet, the grid should display 2-3 columns
* On mobile, the grid should display 1 column
* Each card should contain:

    * An image with appropriate alt text
    * A title 
    * A short description text
    * A call-to-action button or link
    
* Cards should have consistent dimensions
* The grid should maintain proper spacing between cards
* The component should be reusable across the site
* Ensure all images load efficiently (consider lazy loading)
* Maintain accessibility standards (proper contrast, focus states, etc.)
* Support keyboard navigation
* If the card has a link:

    * Button or link are displayed
    * The Card get's a hover state to encourage interaction
    * The whole card is clickable
    
        * on click: change state back to default
